claim: A Lambda function configured to access resources in a VPC does not have access to the internet as its default configuration.
note: FAQ wording. The FAQ's next sentence ('use internet gateways') was cut from the evidence: the developer guide routes internet access through a NAT gateway (lambda-vpc-public-subnet-no-internet); teach the guide.

evidence.quote: Lambda functions configured to access resources in a particular VPC will not have access to the internet as a default configuration.
